subject: Stratified Health — Private-deploy / air-gapped operations evidence
messages:
From: Ava Thompson <ava.thompson@stratifiedhealth.com>
To: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Cc: nate.rivera@stratifiedhealth.com, procurement@stratifiedhealth.com
Date: Fri, 15 Sep 2028 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: RFI — operational evidence for air-gapped private deployment

Hi Rishi,

Thanks for taking the call yesterday. As we formalize our procurement packet we need concrete evidence around day-2 operator activities for an air-gapped/private deployment model. Specifically, can you provide: 1) a runnable operator runbook (day-0 -> day-2 -> incident), 2) SBOM export and verification steps for patch windows, 3) key management workflow (KMS/HSM) with offline key rotation, and 4) examples of what telemetry/metrics are available from an isolated installation (what is collected locally vs what requires outbound connectivity).

Our timeline: internal security review next Thu (2028-09-21). If you can send artifacts and a short summary by EOD Monday (2028-09-18) that would be ideal.

Regards,
Ava Thompson
Head of Infrastructure Security
Stratified Health

Attachments: none
From: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
To: Ava Thompson <ava.thompson@stratifiedhealth.com>, nate.rivera@stratifiedhealth.com
Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 15 Sep 2028 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: RFI — operational evidence for air-gapped private deployment

Ava — thanks for the clear list and timeline. We can provide a consolidated packet addressing each bullet and include an operator-focused runbook tailored for air-gapped installs. High-level notes up-front:

- Runbook: we will send a PDF runbook with step-by-step day-0/day-2/operator recovery playbooks and a short annotated checklist for operator handoffs.
- SBOM: we’ll include a machine-readable SBOM export plus guidance for verifying integrity during offline patch windows.
- KMS: we support customer-managed KMS/HSM integrations and offline key rotation patterns; will include an example sequence diagram and key escrow options.
- Telemetry: default isolated deployments collect purely local telemetry (process health, operator audit logs, local usage metrics). Optional outbound telemetry can be staged via an operator-controlled aggregation host when allowed.

We’ll attach artifacts and a short executive summary by EOD Monday. Looping in Vanessa for runbook approvals and Marissa for procurement/commercial notes.

Thanks,
Rishi Malhotra
Head of Field Engineering — Private Deployments
Redwood Inference

Attachments: none
From: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
To: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 18 Sep 2028 09:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Internal — package for Stratified RFI (draft artifacts)

Team — draft packet attached. Quick notes on contents in the Drive folder: runbook (redwood-operator-runbook-v1.2.pdf), SBOM export (sbom-summary-20280914.json), KMS flow diagram (kms-keyflow-diagram.png), and a short one-page summary (rfi-exec-summary.txt). I also added a redline-ready paragraph for our standard offline-support SLA we can surface to procurement.

Action items:
- Rishi: confirm PS/eng sign-off on runbook steps A6 (operator key rotation) and B3 (upgrade rollback).
- Karthik: confirm legal/commercial note about license OSI/third-party components in SBOM (we must not expose internal build pipelines).
- Marissa: prepare a cover email and attach the commercial appendix with our proposed 12-month advisory engagement (optional).

I’ve left inline comments on the runbook where we should add remediation play examples for lost operator keys. Pinging Karthik separately.

— Vanessa
Director, Solutions Engineering
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood-operator-runbook-v1.2.pdf, sbom-summary-20280914.json, kms-keyflow-diagram.png
From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 18 Sep 2028 12:06:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Internal — package for Stratified RFI (draft artifacts)

Vanessa — reviewed SBOM and the suggested commercial language. A few legal/compliance pointers:

- SBOM export: good to include a verified SHA256 manifest and an example verification command (we should avoid shipping CI credentials or build hashes tied to internal artifact stores).
- License exposure: include a short disclaimer noting that third-party components are listed per SPDX and that we will provide a redacted full SBOM under NDA if they require line-item provenance.
- KMS flow: acceptable. Add a brief note about HSM-backed key wrapping patterns and that customer retains root key material in their HSM.

I’ve attached suggested wording in the Drive doc. Once Rishi signs off on the runbook items we can finalize.

Karthik Iyer
Sr. Counsel, Commercial & Privacy
Redwood Inference

Attachments: none (link to Drive doc provided)
From: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
To: Ava Thompson <ava.thompson@stratifiedhealth.com>, nate.rivera@stratifiedhealth.com
Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 18 Sep 2028 16:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: RFI — operational evidence for air-gapped private deployment

Ava — attaching the packet per your request. Highlights below and quick answers inline for your security review:

Attachments (sent): redwood-operator-runbook-v1.2.pdf; sbom-summary-20280914.json; kms-keyflow-diagram.png

- Runbook: includes day-0 provisioning, day-2 operator tasks, maintenance window checklist, and an incident rollback appendix. We include explicit operator commands that run locally; no external callbacks are required for standard ops.
- SBOM: provided as SPDX/JSON and a summarized export; we include a recommended offline verification step (sha256sum + signature verification using a customer-imported verification key).
- KMS: diagram shows an HSM-protected customer master key; we support manual offline rotation via import/export of wrapped keys and provide a scripted sequence in the runbook.
- Telemetry: local-only telemetry items listed in runbook (process health, operator audit logs, local token counters). Optional outbound aggregation is documented and operator-controlled.

Next steps: please confirm if your team needs the full (unredacted) SBOM under NDA or if the summary is sufficient for the security review. We can also schedule a 45-minute runbook walkthrough with your operators this week.

Best,
Rishi Malhotra
Head of Field Engineering — Private Deployments
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood-operator-runbook-v1.2.pdf (application/pdf, 1.8MB); sbom-summary-20280914.json (application/json, 420KB); kms-keyflow-diagram.png (image/png, 120KB)
